notes.title: Update 1.2.0 Now Available! Now with Workshop Integration!
notes.content:
This is the largest update so far! Thank you for all your patience!

Major

Integration into Steam Workshop! You can now create, upload and share your campaigns!
The ships you create for your campaigns will be uploaded also.
Weapons and buildings are also included, however there is no in-game editor for these at present! You can manually modify the files to get the weapons and buildings you want!

Minor

Fix for opening report window when autoresolve dialog was in use.
Remove clicks for when only one campaign or faction on New Game screen
Fix for Prize Money achievement. It should now unlock correctly.
Added campaign name to save game selection.


Please note that the Steam Workshop integration is still a work in progress. I'll be releasing further updates soon!

Eric

notes.title: Update 1.1.2 Now Available!
notes.content:
This is an intermediate fix aimed at resolving an ongoing issue with different localisations.

Major

 Fix for cultural issue with loading from save files

Minor

Game will ask new players if they want to play the tutorial first (this is highly recommended!)
De-selects defeated fleet after autoresolve

notes.title: Quick Update - January 2019
notes.content:
Hello all and welcome to 2019!

I've been busy working on the next big update for Fleet Star V - Steam Workshop integration!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33709549/6b64911d48de60c7cc0cfe5a6e834d6fd965040c.jpg

Fleet Star V was designed so users could create their own ships and campaigns. The next step is to allow all players to share their creations on the Steam Workshop.

A lot of work has been completed, and there is yet more to be done before the next release.

Many thanks for your continued support, and I look forward to seeing your creations soon!

Eric

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Now Available!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33709549/6fc50a7bd9d889c8ea3980a1c89d62f26885ed1e.png

Major

Can now repair ships manually, rather than waiting for ship to be repaired gradually at end of each turn. Be carful as this will use up double the material! Look for the [REPAIR] button on the ship report!

Minor

Settings file will now be automatically copied over to your 'C:\Users\USER\Documents\Fleet Star V' directory. This will be copied from the BaseSettings.xml file in the game directory.
Campaign screen - stops notification behind close report button from being clicked when closing report.
Tooltip writing colour modified from white to 'thistle'. This makes the tooltips easier to read against a backdrop of white text.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Now Available
notes.content:
Major

Tutorial section now available - learn the basics of the campaign and battle screens!
New achievement - Graduation Day (complete the tutorial).

Minor

Adds battle preview bar. You can now compare your fleet to your enemy's fleet!
Updated rotation tool so you can see the representation of the selected ship.
Fix for user input still used when game window is not active.
Campaign Builder - new buttons to select tools.
Campaign Builder - can now reposition locations.
Campaign Builder - keyboard delete button can now be used (along with 'Delete' UI button) to remove locations.
Reduced building material and recruit rewards.
Fixed issue with camera moving when mouse is over controls at side of screen.
Fixed issue with load save dialog box still clickable when hidden.
When repairing, the crew will now focus primarily on the reactor and medical bay, then the rest of the ship.
Remove unused  elements from saved game files.

notes.title: Next Update - Tutorial
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks to everyone who has played Fleet Star V and taken the time to provide wonderful feedback!

One of the points raised was the lack of a tutorial to assist with the campaign map and battles. The next update (scheduled for later this week) will include a brand new tutorial section.

Thank you all for your continued interest in Fleet Star V. Your support is greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 Now Available
notes.content:
Thank you all for your amazing support in the Community Hub!

Updates
Major

 Set localisation as en-GB, rather than system specific culture. This is to fix issues with data formats, such as dates and decimals/commas.
 Improved logging. Game will attempt to write to the Windows event log as well as to a physical log file.

Minor

 Player's defeated fleet will be deselected automatically when returning to campaign map

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Now Available
notes.content:
IMPORTANT
There has been an issue with save files and error logs being created in the game's local directory. This is to do with permissions. If you want to continue playing your existing campaigns, please do the following:

Step 1
1) Go to %UserProfile%\Documents - this is a shortcut to your user documents (e.g. C:\Users\Eric\Documents)
2) Create a new folder called 'Fleet Star V'
3) In 'Fleet Star V', create a new folder called 'Saved Games'

Step 2:
1) Go to Steam, in your library right-click on 'Fleet Star V' and click 'Properties'
2) Under the 'LOCAL FILES' tab, click 'BROWSE LOCAL FILES...'
3) Open the 'Saved Games' folder. Copy your saved games over to the 'Saved Games' folder created in step 1.

Why is my campaign screen so large now?
This is a quick fix to resolve the issue with those with resolutions of 1440p and higher. In a future update, the base campaign will be resized to fit the new dimensions.
**************************************************************
Updates

TLDR:

 Resolutions of up to 4000 * 2250 now supported.
 Save files will be stored in user's documents directory.
 Error logs will be stored in user's documents directory.


 Campaign background can either be a single image or multiple textures. This is so the game can support all resolutions, though this is dependent on the texture size used in the campaign. Currently the default campaign size is 4000 * 2250, though this can be increased or decreased, thanks to easy modding! I will provide more details on modding in the weeks to come.
 Saved game files moved to user documents directory.
 Error logs now created in user documents directory.

notes.title: Issue With 1440p Resolutions and Higher. Hotfix Incoming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Users who play Fleet Star V with a resolution of 1440p or higher will encounter a 'flickering' screen when viewing the campaign map and campaign builder screens.

This is caused by the base campaign map being too small to fit the resolution. The game engine tries to reposition the camera to accomadate, thus the 'flickering' screen.

I'm working on a hotfix now and hope to get this out to you ASAP.

My apologies for the issue, and many thanks for your patience!
